course.title: Product Design -II
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A helical spring is to fit about a $\frac { 1 1 } { 1 6 }$ in. rod with a free length 2.75 in. or less. A maximum load of 8 lb is to produce a deflection of 1.75 in. The spring is expected to compress less than 5000 times during its life, but is subjected tò relatively high temperature and corrosive atmosphere. Select a material and determine the necessary wire size, mean coil diameter and a number of active coil for square and ground ends. Confirm the all general conditions for this spring
